tasks.title: Bound the serviceWorker.ready wait so enableDailyReminder/bootstrap never hang
acceptance_criteria: enableDailyReminder() resolves even when navigator.serviceWorker.ready never settles (bounded by a short timeout, ~3s).
When permission is not 'granted', enableDailyReminder() still returns early without waiting on serviceWorker.ready.
When a service worker is active, enabling still posts { type: 'CHECK_REMINDERS' } to registration.active.
A rejection from navigator.serviceWorker.ready is swallowed and does not reject enableDailyReminder().
bootstrap() applies the same bounded wait and never hangs on serviceWorker.ready.
Public signatures of enableDailyReminder() and bootstrap() are unchanged (Promise<void>).
tests: enableDailyReminder resolves within the timeout when serviceWorker.ready never resolves
enableDailyReminder posts CHECK_REMINDERS to the active worker when ready resolves before the timeout
enableDailyReminder returns early and does not touch serviceWorker when permission is not granted
bootstrap resolves within the timeout when serviceWorker.ready never resolves for a granted permission

out_of_scope: NotificationScreen UI and its requesting/finally logic
